usageNotes: Triggers an LDAP/AD or other external directory sync for a configured realm, pulling users into PDM. Returns a UPID — poll the task log to confirm completion before assuming users are available. Use `dry-run: true` first to preview what would be created, deleted, or updated without making any changes; this is especially important when `remove-vanished` includes `entry` or `acl`, as those options permanently remove users and their ACLs from PDM if they disappear from the source.

examples.summary: Sync the corporate LDAP realm, enabling new users immediately and removing stale entries and ACLs

tips: Run with `dry-run: true` before your first production sync — the response UPID still represents a real task log you can inspect to see what would change.

`remove-vanished: "properties"` strips custom attributes from existing users that are no longer present in the directory source; use carefully if you manage any PDM-local properties outside the directory.
The sync is asynchronous; poll `get_nodes_node_tasks_upid_status` (PVE) or the PDM task endpoint with the returned UPID to detect failures.
Requires the realm to already be configured under `/access/domains/{realm}` before syncing.
